audience.text: Go developers building applications that need to generate, read, or modify Excel spreadsheets programmatically without external native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Read and write cell values using A1-style references with Cells.Get and Cells.Set, supporting string, float64, int, and bool types.
capabilities.title: Cell data manipulation

capabilities.text: Store formulas with Cell.SetFormula and evaluate them using the built-in CalculateFormula engine for SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN functions.
capabilities.title: Formula evaluation

capabilities.text: Apply comprehensive styling including font properties, fill colors, alignment, and borders via Style objects and Cell.SetStyle.
capabilities.title: Visual styling

capabilities.text: Define and attach data validation rules such as dropdown lists and numeric range restrictions using DataValidation with custom error messages.
capabilities.title: Data validation

capabilities.text: Create Excel tables with headers and auto-filters using Worksheet.AddTable and Table objects with style names.
capabilities.title: Structured tables

capabilities.text: Embed PNG or JPEG images into worksheets using Picture objects with anchor positioning via Worksheet.AddPicture.
capabilities.title: Picture embedding

capabilities.text: Import data from CSV files using Workbook.ImportFromCSV and export worksheet data to CSV using Workbook.ExportToCSV or Worksheet.ToCSV.
capabilities.title: CSV import and export

capabilities.text: Apply ECMA-376 Agile Encryption to workbooks using Workbook.SetPassword and verify passwords with Workbook.VerifyPassword.
capabilities.title: Password protection

limitations.text: Cell references are A1-style strings only; tuple/array indices are not supported.
CalculateFormula supports only SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN; other formulas return an error.
CSV import stores every field as a Go string without inferring numeric or boolean types.
Round-trip fidelity depends on preserving unmodified XML content verbatim rather than full re-serialization.
Generated XML follows ECMA-376 element ordering and is not independently configurable.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel file creation and editing in Go using a pure-Go implementation with zero third-party dependencies.
Supports low-memory processing of large Excel files via streaming row access, avoiding full workbook loading into memory.
Provides built-in formula evaluation for common functions (SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN) without requiring external calculation engines.
Allows password-based workbook encryption using ECMA-376 Agile Encryption (SHA-512 key derivation, AES-256-CBC).

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Go is a pure-Go library for creating, reading, and writing Excel workbooks in ECMA-376 Office Open XML .xlsx format with no third-party dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported formula functions beyond SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN is not explicitly listed in facts.
Whether streaming reader supports writing or only reading is not stated in facts.
The behavior of CalculateFormula when encountering undefined names or external references is not specified.
Whether password-protected workbooks can be opened without providing the password is not stated.
The maximum file size or row count supported by the streaming reader is not provided.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook using NewWorkbook, write cell values via Cells.Set, and save to disk using Workbook.Save.

workflows.name: Load and edit workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing workbook using LoadWorkbook, read cell values via Cells.Get, update cells, and save the modified workbook.

workflows.name: Apply formatting
workflows.text: Create Style objects with Font, Fill, Alignment, and Border properties, then apply them to cells using Cell.SetStyle.

workflows.name: Add data validation
workflows.text: Configure DataValidation rules with type, formula, and error settings, then attach them to worksheet ranges using Worksheet.AddDataValidation.

workflows.name: Import from CSV
workflows.text: Import data from a CSV file into a new workbook using Workbook.ImportFromCSV with a specified delimiter.

workflows.name: Stream large files
workflows.text: Process large Excel files row-by-row using StreamingReader.ProcessRows to minimize memory usage.
